notes: Fiscal year ended May 31, 2026 (Oracle fiscal 2026; data.js fy 'May 2026'). Financials from the FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001193125-26-277521, filed June 22, 2026); ownership from the proxy published after that fiscal year, the 2026 DEF 14A (accession 0001193125-26-402816, filed September 25, 2026, record date September 21, 2026). Ellison is Executive Chair and Chief Technology Officer; Clayton M. Magouyrk and Michael D. Sicilia are co-Chief Executive Officers. Ellison's 1,158,375,174 shares include 142,821 shares under options exercisable within 60 days, and 413,000,000 of the shares are pledged as collateral for personal indebtedness (proxy footnote 2). His percentage fell from 41.6% in the 2024 proxy mainly because the share count grew: Oracle issued 141 million shares through a $20 billion at-the-market offering in the quarter ended August 31, 2026 (Q1 FY2027 10-Q). pctVoting is null because the proxy states percent of class only; with one class of one-vote common shares it would be the same figure. The 2026 proxy lists no other holder above 5%, so largestHolders is empty. Dividends are the cash-flow line 'Payments of dividends to stockholders' ($5,787 million), which includes preferred: the equity statement shows $5,725 million of common dividends ($2.00 per share) and $103 million of preferred dividends declared. Buybacks ($95 million) exclude the separate $111 million of shares repurchased for tax withholding on vesting awards. Stock comp is total stock-based compensation expense ($4,811m), matching the cash-flow add-back.

footprint.notes: Oracle publishes no state or country economic-impact report that was found, and its FY2026 10-K (year ended May 31, 2026) gives no property or headcount breakdown by state or country beyond the U.S./international employee split (49,000 U.S., 92,000 international of ~141,000 full-time employees) and the long-lived assets by country in its geographic note (U.S., UK, Germany, Japan, other). Item 2 gives the owned Austin HQ (~0.9M sq ft), ~25.4M sq ft of other office facilities "in various other locations in the U.S. and abroad" (about 45% sublet or marketed for sublease), the leased Hillsboro, Oregon hardware plant, and "approximately 181 data center locations globally, substantially all of which are leased" (no locations listed). Oracle's public cloud region list exists on oracle.com but is a list of locations with no figures and was not recorded. The "Outside the U.S." employee region and the "Other countries" long-lived-asset region are different groupings (the latter excludes UK, Germany and Japan).

source.quote: The fiscal 2026 total compensation of Mr. Magouyrk was $627,472,419, the fiscal 2026 total compensation of Mr. Sicilia was $256,606,752 and the fiscal 2026 total compensation of our median global employee was $94,740.

pay.notes: Employees: approximate full-time count at May 31, 2026 from the FY2026 10-K (the proxy's pay-ratio section counts approximately 143,950 employees on the same date, including other than full-time staff). Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or personnel costs, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for fiscal 2026 is used; it is the same year as the head count. Oracle identified the median from base salaries and wage rates of its May 31, 2026 employee population, excluding about 5% of employees in eleven countries. The ratios are 6,623:1 (Magouyrk) and 2,709:1 (Sicilia).
